gap: No result ChatGPT got puts the two cited TP-Link pages side by side to show that the Kasa EP10, which ChatGPT picked as 'best for simple timers', is not on the list of plugs with the on-device Auto-Off Timer. That list covers all Tapo plugs plus only Kasa EP40M, KP125M and EP25 V2. On the EP10, 'shut off X minutes after every switch-on' has to be built as a Kasa Smart Action, and TP-Link says those automations need the plug online.
standout_why: I compared against the two cited pages, tapo.com/us/faq/83 and tp-link.com/us/support/faq/947, and against the Kasa EP10 product page. FAQ 83 already lists which plugs have Auto-Off, and FAQ 947 already says Smart Actions need internet, so each half of the finding is on a cited page. No page links the two to ChatGPT's own EP10 pick. My price findings add little: TP-Link, Kasa and Tapo pages show no prices, Amazon was walled, Home Depot and B&H returned 403, and Best Buy timed out. So I could not open a page with today's price for any card ChatGPT showed.
decides: It backs ChatGPT's Tapo pick, the TP15 / P125M with Matter, for anyone who wants the plug to turn off on its own after every manual switch-on, the 'Automatic shutoff' option ChatGPT offered. For that use it moves the Kasa EP10 behind the Kasa EP25 V2 or any Tapo plug. Our Minoston Z-Wave plugs (MP22Z $26.35, MP24Z $28.89) do have schedules and countdown timers, but they lose for this shopper because they need a Z-Wave hub. None of the three ChatGPT-picked plugs I could check needs a hub (Kasa EP10, Kasa EP25, Tapo TP15). The Defiant is labelled 'Powered by Hubspace', but I did not open a page that confirms it works without a hub.

findings.label: Plugs with the device-level Auto-Off Timer
findings.value: All Tapo smart plugs, plus Kasa EP40M, KP125M and EP25 V2 only
findings.source_title: How to Set Up Schedule, Away Mode, and Timer for TP-Link Plug/Bulb/Switch in the Tapo App | Tapo
findings.note: Auto-Off turns the plug off a set time after each switch-on and is set in Device Settings. Kasa EP10 and EP40 (non-M) are not on the list.

findings.label: Kasa auto-off workaround and its internet need
findings.value: Smart Action with the same plug as trigger and action plus a Delay Action; multi-device Smart Actions 'use automation, so the devices must be connected to the internet'
findings.source_title: Kasa Schedule, Away Mode and Timer Setup for Smart Plugs, Bulbs and Switches | TP-Link
findings.note: The page's own example is a KP105 that turns off 10 minutes after it turns on. The internet requirement is stated for Smart Actions/automations. The page does not say whether single-device schedules run offline.

findings.label: Timer features stated by the maker
findings.value: Weekly schedule, countdown timer (on or off), Away mode; 15 A / 1800 W resistive; sold as EP10, EP10P2 (2-pack), EP10P4 (4-pack)
findings.note: The page has no price, only Buy Now links to Amazon. It does not mention Matter or energy monitoring.
